mechanism: Both drugs increase serum potassium through different mechanisms (spironolactone via aldosterone antagonism, candesartan via angiotensin II inhibition), significantly elevating hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antihypertensive if potassium >5.5 mEq/L or creatinine clearance <30 mL/min; educate patient on potassium-restricted diet.
